title: Canonicalize OpenHero as an optional web creative asset reference provider behind provider-neutral admission
rationale: OpenHero provides a useful cinematic hero asset registry, preview, HTML/Next.js packaging and CDN delivery pattern for FA3 marketing/web publishing.
OpenHero is not an AI runtime, workflow authority, rights authority, asset registry authority or deployment control plane.

The upstream preview/download routes derive filesystem paths from request category/slug values and the submission admission uses broad substring-based external-script allowlisting, so upstream runtime code is not directly production-admitted.
FA3 separates repository MIT code licensing from per-asset media rights and requires isolated active-content preview plus immutable publication evidence.
